scope.zh: 修复初始化期间提前缓存的旧文档覆盖与后续编辑事件漏发窗口；在读操作内原子取得当前文档快照、安装监听器并创建首次didOpen future；didOpen与didChange共用既有FIFO dispatcher，移除500ms经验性等待。
preserves: LSP4IJ transport, queue observation, cancellation and notification futures
Existing waitForDidOpen return behavior, including returning without waiting when false
Workspace folder I/O outside the document critical section
limitations: Not a claim that all LSP request/editor races are solved
Requests such as codeAction still do not flush pending didChange before dispatch
Native runtime validation and packaged-binary integration are owned by the main task
Existing stop/disconnect versus asynchronous connect lifecycle behavior is preserved; this patch does not claim to close all disposal races

initialVerification.status: Standalone source compilation at patch creation; later integration and native results are recorded in docs/verification/lsp-document-sync.md
initialVerification.requiredClassReplacement: All generated LanguageServerWrapper*.class and DocumentContentSynchronizer*.class, not only their outer classes

regressionTest.status: Prepared; main task must run against the actual patched dependency classes
regressionTest.uses: Real public LanguageServerWrapper.connect/sendNotification, DocumentContentSynchronizer, native Document and ReadAction; held initialization and in-memory remote only

sequence: Disk already contains 47 LF fixture; didOpen v1 sends older 41 LF overlay
codeAction range (42,5)..(42,19) returns code 0: column is beyond end of file

rawGoplsProbe.scope: Protocol-level reproduction; native reproduction and wire trace are recorded separately by the main task
